name: GLM Quota
author: tomasWade
description: GLM token quota as a thermometer-style bar: mercury fill = quota used, floating pointer = time through the window. Click for the 5-hour and weekly breakdown.

barWidget.description: Thermometer bar: fill = weekly token usage, floating pointer = time through the week. Click: 5-hour + weekly details.

schema.label: Refresh interval (minutes)
schema.description: How often to poll the BigModel quota API. The script layer caches for 4 minutes, so values below that hit the same numbers.

schema.label: API key file
schema.description: File with the BigModel API key on a single line. Must be a regular file (not a symlink) owned by you with chmod 600 — anything less private is rejected. Empty uses api.key next to the plugin directory.

schema.label: Language
schema.description: UI language: auto (follow system locale), zh, or en.

schema.label: Demo data
schema.description: Render canned numbers instead of fetching, for previewing the visuals.
